label: v356
changes: Admins can now change how someone's dates are hidden without undoing it first. In Settings, under "Hidden dates", every hidden person has "Change who": pick "Just for me", "Everyone in this family" or "Choose who" and tick exactly who shouldn't see them. The new choice replaces the old one.

"Choose people to hide" now offers "Choose who" to admins too, so you can hide several people from chosen accounts at once. A person who is already hidden has "Change who" on their card as well, so the card is never a dead end.
If a change only half saves, the person stays hidden from more people rather than fewer, and the row tells you what's still hidden so you can try again.
